eye.note: eye.height = camera Z above floor. horizon is normalized screen Y: values below 0.5 look downward and reveal more nearby floor. playerHeightFactor blends floor height: eyeZ = height + floorH*playerHeightFactor

surface.note: wallDarkenSide multiplies albedo for Y-facing walls (side==1) for ambient directionality

geometry.note: wallHeight is the standard wall's world-space height and is live-editable; set it to 1.0 for square 1x1 wall tiles. floorBaseline/ceilBaseline are fallbacks when map tex is missing.
